def fit(ps, name):
    n = len(ps)
    zs = [p["z"] for p in ps]
    fs = [p["fz"] for p in ps]
    # F = a + b z, k = -b
    mz = sum(zs)/n
    mf = sum(fs)/n
    varz = sum((z-mz)**2 for z in zs)
    cov = sum((z-mz)*(f-mf) for z,f in zip(zs,fs))
    b = cov/varz
    a = mf - b*mz
    resid = [f - (a+b*z) for z,f in zip(zs,fs)]
    ss = sum(r*r for r in resid)
    # z at F=0
    z0 = -a/b if b else None
    print(f"{name}: n={n} k={-b:.4f} N/mm  intercept_z0={z0:.4f}  rms={ (ss/n)**0.5:.4f} N")
    for z,f,r in zip(zs,fs,resid):

    return -b

def fit(ps, name):
    n = len(ps)
    zs = [p["z"] for p in ps]
    fs = [p["fz"] for p in ps]
    # F = a + b z, k = -b
    mz = sum(zs)/n
    mf = sum(fs)/n
    varz = sum((z-mz)**2 for z in zs)
    cov = sum((z-mz)*(f-mf) for z,f in zip(zs,fs))
    b = cov/varz
    a = mf - b*mz
    resid = [f - (a+b*z) for z,f in zip(zs,fs)]
    ss = sum(r*r for r in resid)
    # z at F=0
    z0 = -a/b if b else None
    print(f"{name}: n={n} k={-b:.4f} N/mm  intercept_z0={z0:.4f}  rms={ (ss/n)**0.5:.4f} N")
    for z,f,r in zip(zs,fs,resid):
        print(f"  z={z:.4f} F={f:.3f} resid={r:.3f}")
    return -b
